title: Cloudflare R2 connector instance config (loams.flow/v1)
description: One Cloudflare R2 instance's settings: the S3 connector's (`loams_connector_objects::s3`) under the `cloudflare-r2` target profile, which defaults `region: auto`. `auth.*` holds secret **names** (D189), exactly the manifest's `secrets`.

prefix.description: The key prefix the source lists under and the sink writes under. Give each sink instance its own.

prefixes.description: Several prefixes to list, one source split each; `prefix` when empty.

allow_http.description: Allow plain HTTP to `endpoint`: development and CI stores only.

virtual_hosted_style.description: Virtual-hosted-style requests (`https://<bucket>.<endpoint>`) instead of path style.

auth.description: Static S3 credentials, as secret names. Absent: the pod's AWS credential chain (`iam`).

access_key_id.description: The access key id. The **name** of a secret in the namespace's store (D189), resolved when the connector connects; never the value.

secret_access_key.description: The secret access key. The **name** of a secret in the namespace's store (D189), resolved when the connector connects; never the value.

session_token.description: A session token for temporary credentials. The **name** of a secret in the namespace's store (D189), resolved when the connector connects; never the value.

source.description: The listing source: one split per prefix, read in lexicographic key order after a high-water key.

decode.description: What each listed object becomes: one `object` event with its metadata (`metadata`) or its bytes (`bytes`), or Arrow batches decoded from CSV, NDJSON or Parquet.

columns.description: The columns of CSV and NDJSON objects, typed with the SDK's SQL type names (required for `csv` and `ndjson`; Parquet carries its own schema).

csv_header.description: CSV objects start with a header line.

poll_interval_ms.description: List again this long after a listing ends. Without it the source lists once and ends (a bounded read).

max_object_bytes.description: Objects larger than this are not decoded or carried; they go to the DLQ as poison and the listing moves past them.

decode_batch_rows.description: Rows per decoded batch before the batch budget cuts it.

sink.description: The rolling sink: files rolled by size or time, named `<prefix>/<instance>/fabric/<first>-<last>.<ext>` after the sink's own row numbers, each Fabric batch staged with its checkpoint first (R13.2).

format.description: The file format: Parquet rows of the CloudEvents envelope, structured-mode CloudEvents as NDJSON, or the events' data (`raw`). Arrow batches keep their own schema.

roll_bytes.description: Roll a file once this many staged bytes are waiting.

roll_interval_secs.description: Roll a file once its first row has waited this long, checked as batches arrive.

conditional_put.description: Publish with `If-None-Match: *`, so a file already at a sink name is never overwritten. Off only for a store that refuses the header, which makes the sink at least once.

raw_separator.description: Raw format: written after each event's data.
